c01.sql:
-- c01  "Show me today's cargo list in West Aussie."  (answered: West Australia)
-- Cargoes loading in West Australia that are on today's book.
--   Loading in West Australia: the load zone is West Australia, or the load
--   port label names it (some enquiries give only the region).
--   Today's book: laycan not cancelled yet, opening within 30 days, circulated
--   in the last 5 days.
--   As of today: received by the working date (see uat/README.md).
SELECT o.order_id::text AS id
FROM order_test o
WHERE o.date_received < $1::date + 1
  AND ('West Australia' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(o.load_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR o.load_port ILIKE '%West Australia%')
  AND o.laycan_end   >= $1::date
  AND o.laycan_start <  $1::date + 31
  AND o.update_date  >= $1::date - 5;

c02.sql:
-- c02  "Show me the latest C3 iron ore orders."  (answered: updated in the last 30 days)
-- C3 is Tubarao to Qingdao. Iron ore includes its grades (fines, pellets, ...).
-- "Latest" names no window, so the agent asks; the scripted answer is the last
-- 30 days of updates.
SELECT o.order_id::text AS id
FROM order_test o
WHERE o.date_received < $1::date + 1
  AND o.load_port      ILIKE '%Tubarao%'
  AND o.discharge_port ILIKE '%Qingdao%'
  AND o.cargo_type     ILIKE '%IRON ORE%'
  AND o.update_date   >= $1::date - 30;

c03.sql:
-- c03  "What orders are loading in ECSA?"  (answered: East Coast South America)
-- Every cargo loading in East Coast South America as of today. Not a list
-- question, so no laycan or recency window.
SELECT o.order_id::text AS id
FROM order_test o
WHERE o.date_received < $1::date + 1
  AND ('East Coast South America' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(o.load_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR o.load_port ILIKE '%East Coast South America%');

c04.sql:
-- c04  "Show me orders from PDM to North China."  (answered: Madeira)
-- PDM is Ponta da Madeira, stored as Madeira. North China is a stored
-- discharge label. No dates asked for.
SELECT o.order_id::text AS id
FROM order_test o
WHERE o.date_received < $1::date + 1
  AND o.load_port      ILIKE '%Madeira%'
  AND o.discharge_port ILIKE '%North China%';

c08.sql:
-- c08  "Iron ore cargoes loading in West Australia in March"  (answered: 2025)
-- A month means the laycan overlaps it: it has not cancelled before 1 March
-- and opens by 31 March.
SELECT o.order_id::text AS id
FROM order_test o
WHERE o.date_received < $1::date + 1
  AND ('West Australia' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(o.load_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR o.load_port ILIKE '%West Australia%')
  AND o.cargo_type ILIKE '%IRON ORE%'
  AND o.laycan_end   >= DATE '2025-03-01'
  AND o.laycan_start <  DATE '2025-04-01';

c09.sql:
-- c09  "Cargoes of at least 170,000 tonnes loading at Tubarao"
-- The whole stem must be at least 170,000 t: a 153,000-187,000 stem does not
-- qualify, so the minimum is what is compared.
SELECT o.order_id::text AS id
FROM order_test o
WHERE o.date_received < $1::date + 1
  AND o.load_port ILIKE '%Tubarao%'
  AND o.cargo_weight_min >= 170000;

v01.sql:
-- v01  "Show me today's tonnage list open in the Pacific."
-- Each vessel at its latest report as of today, open in the Pacific, on
-- today's book: open window not closed yet, opening within 30 days, updated
-- in the last 5 days.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE ('Pacific' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(v.parent_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR v.open_area ILIKE '%Pacific%')
  AND v.open_date_end   >= $1::date
  AND v.open_date_start <  $1::date + 31
  AND v.update_date     >= $1::date - 5;

v02.sql:
-- v02  "Show me the ECSA ballasters."  (answered: East Coast South America)
-- Each vessel at its latest report as of today, in ballast, open in East
-- Coast South America. Not a list question, so no window.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE ('East Coast South America' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(v.parent_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR v.open_area ILIKE '%East Coast South America%')
  AND v.ballast_laden = 'BALLAST';

v03.sql:
-- v03  "Show me the WAF openers."  (answered: West Africa)
-- Each vessel at its latest report as of today that comes open in West
-- Africa. "Openers" is read as where the vessel opens, with no fixture-status
-- filter; confirm that reading with the sponsor.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE 'West Africa' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(v.parent_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
   OR v.open_area ILIKE '%West Africa%';

v04.sql:
-- v04  "Show me open vessels in the Far East of at least 180,000 dwt."
-- Each vessel at its latest report as of today, open in the Far East, at
-- least 180,000 dwt, and free today. A vessel is FIXED or ON SUBS only while
-- that fixture's open window covers today; otherwise it is open.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE ('Far East' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(v.parent_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR v.open_area ILIKE '%Far East%')
  AND v.dwt >= 180000
  AND NOT (COALESCE(v.commercial_status, '') IN ('FIXED', 'ON SUBS')
           AND v.open_date_start < $1::date + 1
           AND v.open_date_end  >= $1::date);
-- COALESCE: without it a vessel with no status whose window covers today
-- makes the condition NULL, NOT NULL is NULL, and the vessel is dropped.

v05.sql:
-- v05  "Which vessels are fixed?"
-- Each vessel at its latest report as of today that is FIXED today: the
-- fixture's open window covers today. A fixture for a later or earlier window
-- leaves the vessel open today.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE v.commercial_status = 'FIXED'
  AND v.open_date_start < $1::date + 1
  AND v.open_date_end  >= $1::date;

v06.sql:
-- v06  "Which vessels open in West Australia were updated in the last 3 days?"
-- Each vessel at its latest report as of today, open in West Australia, with
-- that report updated on or after today minus 3 days.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE ('West Australia' = ANY (regexp_split_to_array(v.parent_zone, '\s*,\s*'))
       OR v.open_area ILIKE '%West Australia%')
  AND v.update_date >= $1::date - 3;

v08.sql:
-- v08  "Which vessels are anchored?"
-- Each vessel whose latest report as of today has the AIS status Anchored.
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.vessel_id) t.*
    FROM tonnage_test t
    WHERE t.update_date < $1::date + 1
    ORDER BY t.vessel_id, t.update_date DESC, t.first_date_received DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT v.vessel_id AS id
FROM latest v
WHERE v.vessel_status = 'Anchored';

v07.sql:
-- v07  "Show me the position history of VESSEL 0743."
-- Every report of VESSEL 0743 up to today, one row per report. Compared by
-- count, since the same vessel appears once per report.
SELECT t.vessel_id AS id
FROM tonnage_test t
WHERE t.vessel_id = 'VESSEL 0743'
  AND t.update_date < $1::date + 1;
